items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I played there with Caroline Snowden

ctx.x: You know that refutes the conception that many people have about jazz musicians as not being qualified to read the music, that you were saying that you had to play for many, many kinds of acts. You certainly had to be qualified.
Some say they had tough shows at the Cotton Club, because I played there with Caroline Snowden, but nothing was tougher than the burlesque show because they were all white.
All of the entertainers were white?
